question: Does sourced can temperature put the reference steel at the fitted resistivity ceiling?

material_source.title: Hust and Giarratano, NBS SRM 798 austenitic stainless steel
material_source.locator: Table 4, p. 18 (PDF p. 30); units micro-ohm cm

bake_source.title: Akers et al., First results from MAST (2001)

public_programme_source.finding: The public programme index gives objectives, not calibrated PF can temperatures. Its 25721–25729 objective mentions TF sliding-joint thermocouple tests, a different component.

method: piecewise-linear interpolation, no extrapolation; reference specimen is not identified as MAST can stock

verdict: indeterminate for all fitted shots; no can resistivity is inferred from vessel bake-out or plasma temperatures
